> Hi Samantha / Tom —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday...

Quick internal notes / suggested clarifications before we send the MAP back to HealthWays:

1) Acceptance-test pass/fail (make binary where possible)
   - Latency: P50 < 120ms, P95 < 350ms under baseline load (defined in MAP). Fail if P95 > 500ms.
   - Accuracy: Top-1 routing accuracy >= 92% on seeded gold set.
   - Hallucination rate: <= 2% on the eval prompts; any hallucination related to PHI -> immediate fail.

2) Exit gates (must be met to move from baseline -> validation -> pilot):
   - Gate A (Env readiness): VPC peering, KMS keys provisioned, audit logging turned on.
   - Gate B (Baseline stability): 24h of stable throughput within 10% of expected traffic and no service errors > 0.1%.
   - Gate C (Safety & Accuracy): No critical hallucination incidents in seeded regression set and accuracy thresholds met.

3) Test ownership and artifacts:
   - Redwood: run baseline perf and KV cache/quantization validation; provide logs and perf dashboard share.
   - HealthWays: provide 2k labeled gold prompts + red-team cases and sign off on retention window.

I also noted a missing item in the pilot-eval-test-suite: a simple deterministic reproducibility check for a fixed seed at 512 tokens; I'll add that to the md.

If that looks good, I can draft the one-pager summary to send to Samantha with a proposed Dec 6 — Dec 17 validation window.

—Jordan
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks Irene / Jordan — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing the MAP and test suite: 

- The acceptance thresholds look reasonable, but we need to add one compliance check: audit logs must include a per-request provenance token that maps back to the original patient record id for full traceability.
- For hallucination, we agree on <= 2% overall, but please add a mandatory manual review process for any flags involving clinical assertions (we prefer triggered sampling of 100 flagged responses per validation week).
- Can you expand the test-suite rubric to include the exact pass/fail metric calculation (numerator/denominator) for the hallucination and routing accuracy checks? We'll need that to sign off internally.

We can tentatively confirm Dec 6 for baseline, but Tom and I need a short session to agree on the gold set and red-team cases. Can you propose 30 minutes on Dec 1 or Dec 2?

Samantha Turner
Head of Clinical Ops
HealthWays
